title: Cảnh theo bậc nâng cấp tầng mây: viền hoa, lối lát, 10 vật mốc, đèn, sinh vật, thác, vầng sáng
decisions: Decision 056 (plot upgrade ranks). Layers shown by rank over the Cloud scene (CLOUD_SCENERY in cloudView.ts); manifest rows scn_cloud_* exist as placeholders, sizes from scripts/assets/sizes.ts. Each asset stands alone on the flat grey. Landmarks are themed on vi.cloud.tierNames and share one canvas 280x300 standing on the bottom edge. scn_cloud_halo is a soft glow that the game blends additively; if a flat-grey cut cannot keep its softness it is better drawn in code (note for triage). No rank border on the art: the game draws the rank frame.
